acceptanceCriteria: a recorded owner decision on the role default and on the fixture scope
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the pre-1.0 panel review addendum (Beamfall fit and corvint-tasks), scratchpad review/out/panel-addendum.md. §5 disputed item 7 and the §3 advertising precondition. cli/mutate.go:98 defaults mutations to --role OWNER (decision 0003, SPEC.md:549,584,1618), and Corvint's real backlog runs with fixture:true while the README says fixture-only. Needs an owner decision before the in-tree companion is advertised as delivered.
title: corvint-tasks: decide the OWNER role default and fixture:true on the real backlog versus the fixture-only scope
